basic_info.title: VectorNet: Encoding HD Maps and Agent Dynamics from Vectorized Representation
basic_info.authors: Jiyang Gao, Chen Sun, Hang Zhao, Yi Shen, Dragomir Anguelov, Congcong Li, Cordelia Schmid (Waymo / Google)
basic_info.code_available: no (no official Waymo release; unofficial third-party implementations exist, e.g. https://github.com/Liang-ZX/VectorNet)

gap_analysis.whats_missing: VectorNet inspires the vectorized graph encoder pillar via its hierarchical polyline sub-graph + global interaction GNN and its masked node-completion self-supervised auxiliary task, but it is a motion-forecasting model for HD-map + agent dynamics, not a GPS map-matching method. It operates on annotated HD-map polylines and tracked agent trajectories (Argoverse / Waymo data), never on raw fleet GPS, and performs no road-segment assignment.
gap_analysis.novelty_vs_recombination_note: A real gap exists: the vectorized hierarchical graph idea has not been applied to label-free GPS-to-road map matching.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Architectural inspiration only for the vectorized graph encoder; it addresses AD motion forecasting on HD maps, not BMW fleet GPS analytics or map matching.
